scripts.dev: echo ---- don't forget to run the dev-ws server before e.g. pnpm dev-ws ---- && vite
scripts.mock:logs: wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --json --command "SELECT id, channel, provider, to_address, datetime(created_at) FROM mock_send_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.cron:check: wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --json --command "SELECT id, contact_id, channel, status, scheduled_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AS now_utc, body FROM scheduled_message ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.cron:next: wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --command "UPDATE scheduled_message SET scheduled_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 minute'), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM scheduled_message WHERE status = 'scheduled' ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC LIMIT 1);" && pnpm cron:trigger && pnpm cron:check
scripts.coming-soon: node -e "const rl = require('readline').createInterface({input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout}); rl.question('Are you sure, this will make the main site look like its under construction? (y/n) ', ans => { if (ans.toLowerCase() === 'y') { require('child_process').execSync('cd empty-warmchats && npx wrangler pages deploy .', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { console.log('Aborted.'); } rl.close(); })"
scripts.upload: pnpm lint && pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.updater: pnpm upgrade --latest && cd gateway-worker && pnpm upgrade --latest && cd ..
scripts.db-fast: powershell -Command "$files = Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sql/*.sql | Sort-Object { if ($_.BaseName -match '^\d+') { [int]($matches[0]) } else { [int]::MaxValue } }; $files | Get-Content | Set-Content _combined_temp.sql -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host 'Executing combined SQL...'; wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --file=_combined_temp.sql; Remove-Item _combined_temp.sql;"
scripts.db-fast-remote: powershell -Command "$files = Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sql/*.sql | Sort-Object { if ($_.BaseName -match '^\d+') { [int]($matches[0]) } else { [int]::MaxValue } }; $files | Get-Content | Set-Content _combined_remote_temp.sql -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host 'Executing combined SQL...'; wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --remote --file=_combined_remote_temp.sql; Remove-Item _combined_remote_temp.sql;"
scripts.db: powershell -Command "$files = Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sql/*.sql | Sort-Object { if ($_.BaseName -match '^\d+') { [int]($matches[0]) } else { [int]::MaxValue } }; $total = $files.Count; $i = 0; foreach ($file in $files) { $i++; Write-Host ('Running {0}/{1}: {2}' -f $i, $total, $file); wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --file=sql\$file; }"
scripts.db-remote: powershell -Command "$confirm = Read-Host 'WARNING: Executing against REMOTE DB. Continue? (y/n)'; if ($confirm -match '^[yY]') { $files = Get-ChildItem -File -Filter sql/*.sql | Sort-Object { if ($_.BaseName -match '^\d+') { [int]($matches[0]) } else { [int]::MaxValue } }; $total = $files.Count; $i = 0; foreach ($file in $files) { $i++; Write-Host ('Running {0}/{1}: {2}' -f $i, $total, $file); wrangler d1 execute warmchats-db --remote --file=sql\$file; } } else { Write-Host 'Operation aborted.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; }"
